title: Manage cash and treasury reserves
summary: When operating cash, currencies or deposit concentration exceed the team's informal cash-management process. An approved cash policy and reconciled liquidity schedule with authorized account and counterparty limits.
outcomes: An approved cash policy and reconciled liquidity schedule with authorized account and counterparty limits.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When operating cash, currencies or deposit concentration exceed the team's informal cash-management process.

parts.title: Forecast cash availability and obligations
parts.guidance: Reconcile bank balances, restricted cash, collections, payroll, taxes and debt commitments by currency and date. Distinguish forecast receipts from cleared funds and show the downside liquidity case.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve liquidity and counterparty constraints
parts.guidance: Finance leadership agrees the operating buffer, permitted accounts or instruments, concentration limits and approval rights. Get qualified advice for deposit protection, investment suitability, tax and currency risks in the relevant jurisdictions.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Prepare a treasury action proposal
parts.guidance: Compare the proposed allocations against forecast obligations, access restrictions, fees and settlement timing. Show how cash would be accessed during an outage or counterparty failure without assuming instant liquidity.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Authorize specific treasury transactions
parts.guidance: The designated approvers review account ownership, counterparties and exact amounts before any transfer or investment. Authorized operators execute through the company payment process and retain independent confirmations.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile positions and review liquidity
parts.guidance: Match transactions and balances to statements, refresh the cash forecast and flag limit breaches. Assign corrective actions and reassess the policy when funding, currencies or operating exposure change.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An approved cash policy and reconciled liquidity schedule with authorized account and counterparty limits.
